Claude doesn’t stop because you sent too many messages.

You hit limits because every chat keeps getting heavier.
Most people waste tokens without even realizing it.
Here’s how power users avoid that:

1. Edit your message instead of sending new ones
Every new reply makes the AI re-read the entire conversation again.
Editing the original prompt = less token usage, same context.

2. Don’t keep one chat forever
Long chats become expensive fast.
After 15–20 messages, summarize the context and start a fresh conversation.

3. Ask everything together
3 separate questions = 3 separate context reloads.
One structured message saves both time and tokens.

4. Choose the model wisely
Not every task needs the most powerful model.
Use lighter models for simple work, save advanced ones for deep reasoning.

5. Reuse files intelligently
Uploading the same documents repeatedly wastes context space.
Projects/workspaces exist for a reason.

P.S. Most people think AI limits are about subscriptions.
In reality, it’s about how efficiently you use context.
